title: Knowledge-heavy tasks (agent loop)
description: Tasks that need API knowledge the coder is weak on and the crawl store covers (libctru/citro2d/NDSP, Godot 4, Ghidra scripting), plus one git task as a weak-crawl control. Built for the crawl retrieval on/off A/B: the project-refactor corpus can only show crawl harm, this one can show benefit. Each task ships a project plus hidden acceptance tests graded with the real toolchain where this PC has it (devkitARM, Ghidra 12.1.2 headless, git + msys bash).
